claim: respinsRef.current is mutated synchronously the instant setRespins runs

The second invocation sees the already-decremented ref value and bails out via the guard
The disabled attribute is applied by React only after re-render, not synchronously
Double-click events can fire before React re-renders and applies the disabled attribute
Key-repeat on a focused button can fire events before React re-renders and applies the disabled attribute
A duplicate touch/click pair can fire events before React re-renders and applies the disabled attribute

The setRespins wrapper handles both plain values and updater functions
